Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild leukopenia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, and increased red cell distribution width, suggesting possible chronic disease or nutritional deficiency. Electrolytes are mostly normal except for mild hyperchloremia and low CO₂, which may indicate mild metabolic acidosis. Lipid profile is markedly abnormal (high cholesterol, LDL, triglycerides), and HbA1c is elevated, indicating poorly controlled diabetes and increased cardiovascular risk. Liver and kidney function are within normal limits. Coagulation parameters are slightly prolonged (aPTT), but INR is normal. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
